filing_fee_notes: Online LLC formation fee; periodic reporting is separate.
registered_agent_rules: Provide a consenting registered agent with a Colorado street address. An individual must reside in Colorado and be at least 18.
annual_report_due: Each year in the entity's listed Periodic Report month; filing is permitted two months before through two months after that month without penalty.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization online. Keep the registered agent current and file the annual Periodic Report.
common_mistake: Skipping the Periodic Report because no information changed.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Report URL requires finding the entity record first. Processing time, LLC-specific expedite availability, franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
